annotations.label: JoystickAbsoluteSample
annotations.comment: Native library22 P5. C070 starts paddle timers; C064/C065 counted in balanced loop. Absolute coordinates, not velocity. annotations.label: ActorMoveCollisionSlide
annotations.comment: Native library22 P22. Try (dx,dy), then (dx,0), then (0,dy); P9 mode2 sets overlap scratch word9000. First unblocked candidate updates caller actor coordinates. SHIP15P13 retries one-pixel deltas when unchanged. REA ev_4d639db5476cf53d2fd3134f0c34c92d65ccb6e5bd4575c40a1c0c0de2923fe8. See docs/ship-actions.md.
